scope: Internal evidence and claim-source ledger for the AutoMF working draft; bibliography supplies canonical titles/URLs for all keys.

claims.claim: Stacking learns combinations from reserved or cross-validated base predictions; residual-product objectives are established.
claims.status: Supported; no novelty claim

claims.claim: Automatic ensemble/library construction and validation-error weighting precede AutoMF.
claims.status: Supported; identical-library Caruana experiment remains missing

claims.claim: Adaptive MF strategy selection already occurs in EL-MFS, AQBMF and MAESTRO.
claims.status: Supported at indicated access levels; no quantitative superiority inferred

claims.claim: MAESTRO was publicly available before the research cutoff although its journal issue is later.
claims.status: SSRN indexed primary metadata gives February 10, 2026; cite preprint, not November issue

claims.claim: Learned field ensembles and automated neural-operator training already exist.
claims.status: Supported; LANE-SI has learned linear/CNN combination, HyperNOs operator HPO; neither should be called our new invention

claims.claim: FNO, DeepONet, WNO, Transolver and ConvNeXt supply distinct architecture building blocks.
claims.status: Supported; local adaptations explicitly distinguished from exact paper reproductions

claims.claim: MF operators and scientific climate/carbon-storage applications already exist.
claims.status: Supported; portfolio study does not originate multifidelity field learning

claims.claim: Fidelity differences and distribution-conditioned residuals have close precedents.
claims.status: Supported; FIRE local trained FNO is an adaptation of a tabular-foundation-model principle

claims.claim: Broad PDE benchmarks motivate cross-system evaluation; active multi-resolution acquisition solves a different task.
claims.status: Supported; local release is not identified with those benchmarks

claims.claim: Gram-risk, ambiguity identity, and bounded-entry perturbation analysis explain mixtures without proving five fields suffice.
claims.status: Elementary derivation, assumptions explicit; 100 algebraic checks do not establish statistical assumptions
claims.location: Analysis (risk identity and explanation); Appendix A (formal bound and proof)

claims.claim: Historical full stacking at K=5 has ratios 0.8743288831 class-balanced and 0.9217276517 equal-dataset, with 14 wins and 6 losses above 1%.
claims.status: Recomputed; historical component results, not complete AutoMF selector scores

claims.claim: Simple inverse-error weighting nearly matches full fitting; uniform averaging is unreliable in this corpus.
claims.status: Supported descriptively; no independent-seed significance claim

claims.claim: Historical design is 20 datasets, 7 descriptive classes, 9 experts and 3 calibration partitions of the same base seed.
claims.status: Supported; calibration counts additional to base HF training, legacy cavity capped at 8

claims.claim: Retrospective 15-dataset audit sensitivity preserves aggregate gains after five exclusions selected by previously documented properties.
claims.status: New descriptive recomputation; not fresh testing or certification of remaining generators

claims.claim: On 128 fresh heat evaluation cases, inverse weighting beats full fitting and LOO shrinkage at tested budgets.
claims.status: Supported; one PDE and one trained expert seed, three calibration draws share evaluation cases

claims.claim: Refreshing mixture weights after changing coarse-input resolution can use the same five known HF answers.
claims.status: Supported for this controlled perturbation; not arbitrary physics/climate shift

claims.claim: Richer global/input/local feature gates did not beat the fixed fallback in the 24 examined configurations.
claims.status: Supported; separate larger calibration experiment, not K=5 feature ablation or impossibility result

claims.claim: Historical ERA5 evaluation inputs overlap LF training, so the repaired protocol purges reserved inputs at every fidelity.
claims.status: Completed ERA5 evaluation: 55 base HF / 10 calibration / 7 evaluation; all 17 reserved inputs excluded at every training fidelity. Reported separately from the 17 PDE aggregate.

claims.claim: ERA5 is reanalysis; the local task is climate-driver emulation, distinct from operational weather forecasting and ClimateBench.
claims.status: Supported with local calendar provenance explicitly unresolved

claims.claim: Simple climate pattern scaling and internal variability are important comparators and confounders.
claims.status: Supported for the cited climate evaluation; recommends controls rather than importing scores to ERA5

claims.claim: Automatic singleton/inverse/full selection is leave-one-out within the same calibration budget, followed by refitting.
claims.status: Completed ERA5 nine expert evaluation: full chosen on every calibration subset at both budgets; final error higher than inverse weighting.

claims.claim: The proposed contribution is an application/evaluation scope at the intersection of established components.
claims.status: Interpretive positioning, not verified priority or proof of acceptance; missing baselines and costs listed

claims.claim: The current manuscript follows the user-supplied ICLR 2026 template and nine-page initial-submission limit.
claims.status: Exact style files from user archive; nine pages before references, appendices after bibliography. Earlier 2027 policy research does not specify the current template.

claims.claim: ERA5 nine expert inverse K5 gives 5.8146% relative L2 versus selected POD GP and training mean 6.7369% (13.69% relative gain); automatic/full gives 6.4877% (3.70% relative gain). POD GP is constant across 17 reserved inputs.
claims.status: Recomputed from the completed nine expert campaign; seven shared evaluation inputs, one base seed. K10 repeats the same calibration pool; not confirmation on new years.

claims.claim: Eight of the nine experts minimize the partition-averaged individual error on at least one of the 20 historical datasets.
claims.status: All 180 means reconstructed from the same archived evaluation rows used by mixtures, with 60 task hash and replay checks. Hindsight descriptive rankings; not a deployment selection rule, new training run, or independent confirmation.

claims.claim: All twelve ERA5 baseline entries are complete, representing eleven independent fits with B10 reusing B9. Fidelity basis FNO (B8) gives 5.1503% mean relative L2 error; autoregressive POD GP gives 5.0032%. Both are below the inverse and fitted mixtures on the same seven evaluation inputs.
claims.status: All baseline per case errors replayed from saved predictions and matched to the completed ORCD production collector. Shared input identities and working grid verified. No new weight fitting.
